story_clusters.headline: Orlen delays KSeF electronic invoicing implementation for gas station customers
story_clusters.summary: Orlen announced that printed invoices for business customers at gas stations will continue to be available until at least April 1, 2026, despite the mandatory e-invoicing system (KSeF) launching February 1. The decision responds to customer demands for a transition period. Other fuel networks follow similar approaches.

story_clusters.headline: Orlen demands immediate loan repayment from Grupa Azoty Polyolefins
story_clusters.summary: PKN Orlen demanded immediate repayment of a loan worth $28.7 million (including interest) from Grupa Azoty Polyolefins, a subsidiary of chemical giant Grupa Azoty. The loan was originally intended to finance propane purchases. The move comes amid ongoing financial difficulties at the Polimery Police project.

story_clusters.headline: Record military conscription wave to include 235,000 people
story_clusters.summary: Poland's Ministry of Defense announced the largest military qualification process in years, involving approximately 235,000 people from February to April 2026. For the first time, the process will include women with relevant qualifications and men up to age 50 with unregulated military status.

story_clusters.headline: Constitutional Tribunal candidate shortlist circulates in ruling coalition
story_clusters.summary: A working list of eight potential candidates from the ruling coalition to fill vacancies in the Constitutional Tribunal is circulating in parliamentary circles. Some individuals on the list have been preliminarily contacted about the possibility, with the selection process aimed at addressing the tribunal's ongoing legitimacy crisis.

story_clusters.headline: Tusk promotes government successes on international stage
story_clusters.summary: Prime Minister Donald Tusk highlighted Poland's achievements in various social media posts and public appearances, including promoting the success of the government's in vitro program and Poland's positive international image. He responded to frequently searched Google questions about Poland and celebrated reaching a historic trillion-dollar GDP milestone.
